question: Do hours with concentrated large swaps precede higher next-hour pool-price realized volatility?
scope: Exploratory historical study of one Ethereum USDC/WETH pool; not a trading-return backtest or live forecast.
primary_effect: Test-set mean next-hour RV in signal hours minus that in non-signal hours, measured in basis points.
secondary_prediction_check: Paired test MAE of current-volatility-plus-signal OLS versus current-volatility OLS; both fitted only on training labels.
threshold_policy: 90th percentile of large_swap_count / swap_count in eligible training hours, linear interpolation; require at least two large swaps and twenty swaps. No threshold search on test outcomes.
time_policy: Decision at the feature-hour end. Features use only events strictly before that time; labels use the following hour. Training labels must end at or before split; test decisions must be at or after split.
inference_policy: A circular moving-block bootstrap resamples the hourly test timeline, retaining gaps. Intervals are exploratory and conditional on the chosen block length and trained parameters.
history_policy: Rules recorded before computing this study's results. These snapshots were already used in project demonstrations, so this is not a prospective or independently preregistered experiment.
